title: Finite-projective chart model for the recorded ordinary tensor
statement: Given a map f:T to X with T qcqs and bounded finite-free-retract cochain models P,Q for the ordinary restrictions of arbitrary K,L, the restriction of the recorded ordinary tensor of K,L has a bounded finite-free-retract cochain representative V. This asserts only the algebraic representative comparison, not completeness of K,L or V.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.5, total tensor step; Stacks Tags 07A2 and 07A4

proof.text: The recorded tensor comparison on K-flat complexes restricts along the inclusion of flat-term K-flat complexes to a pro-etale tensor model. Compare the actual completed coefficient maps by uniqueness of their finite quotient projections. Uniqueness of module adjoints and of total left derived functors identifies ordinaryDerivedPull with the recorded ringed pullback.

Finite-free retracts are flat: tensoring with the term is a retract of tensoring with a finite free sheaf. Bounded-above complexes of flat sheaves are K-flat. Tensor two termwise splittings, distribute the tensor of finite free sheaves, and sum the finitely many possible terms in each total degree. This makes each total term a retract of a finite free sheaf. The support intervals add, including the zero and rank-zero cases.

Apply the canonical tensor-pullback comparison to the two pro-etale tensor models. Conjugate by the ordinary/ringed pullback isomorphism, transport the supplied isomorphisms to P,Q, and apply the recorded K-flat total-tensor representative comparison. The resulting isomorphism presents the restriction of the original specified tensor by the explicit total complex.

theorem projectiveChartOrdinaryTensorModel {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T] (f : T ⟶ X)
    (K L : IntegralOnSlice.D.{u, u} l E X none)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ℤ)
    (hbP : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ k : ℤ, k < a ∨ b < k → IsZero (P.X k))
    (hbQ : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ k : ℤ, k < a ∨ b < k → IsZero (Q.X k))
    (hP : (∀ k : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ,
            ∃ i : P.X k ⟶ ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
              (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E T)),
            ∃ p : (∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
              (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E T))) ⟶ P.X k,
            i ≫ p = 𝟙 _))
    (hQ : (∀ k : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ,
            ∃ i : Q.X k ⟶ ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
              (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E T)),
            ∃ p : (∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
              (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E T))) ⟶ Q.X k,
            i ≫ p = 𝟙 _))
    (eP : Nonempty ((IntegralOnSlice.ordinaryDerivedPull.{u, u} l E f).obj K ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
    (eQ : Nonempty ((IntegralOnSlice.ordinaryDerivedPull.{u, u} l E f).obj L ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)) :
    ∃ V : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ℤ,
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ k : ℤ, k < a ∨ b < k → IsZero (V.X k)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ,
            ∃ i : V.X k ⟶ ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
              (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E T)),
            ∃ p : (∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin r ↦ SheafOfModules.unit
              (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E T))) ⟶ V.X k,
            i ≫ p = 𝟙 _) ∧
      Nonempty ((IntegralOnSlice.ordinaryDerivedPull.{u, u} l E f).obj
        ((IntegralSystemRealization.calculus l E X).integralClosed.tensor.obj (K, L)) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj V)
